_doc: Allowlist for the RLS policy guard at scripts/check_rls_policies.js. Every entry MUST include a real reason that survives review. The guard fails CI if anything outside this file goes permissive or RLS-off.

permissive_policies.reason: Anon storefront analytics — insert-only event log used by the storefront grid to record view/add-to-cart events for funnel analysis. Append-only; admins read.

Reactions are visible to any participant of the conversation. Legacy policy from messenger v1; safe because participation is enforced on the parent messenger_messages SELECT policy and reactions only ever join through it.

Link previews are unfurled URLs (title, image, description). They contain no user-specific data; visible to all authenticated users so any participant who later sees the message can render the preview.
Stores the public-facing referral bonus amounts shown on /referrals and inside the agent dashboard. Single-row config table; no PII.
Public flat-rate shipping tiers shown on the checkout page and the public Shipping page. Anonymous quotes must work pre-login.
Public research knowledge base — compound monographs are the site's public catalog/SEO content. Read-only; writes gated by admin policies.
Published literature citations (PMID/DOI) rendered on public monograph pages. No user data; writes require is_admin().
Cache of public PubMed API responses used to render evidence tabs. Source data is already public; writes require is_admin().
ClinicalTrials.gov records (public registry data) shown on monograph Trials tabs. Writes require is_admin().
WADA prohibited-list history (public regulatory data) shown on monographs. Writes require is_admin().
Citation footnotes for monograph facts — public evidence layer. Writes require is_admin().
UniProt ortholog data (public bioinformatics data) on monographs. Writes require is_admin().
ChEMBL binding-affinity data (public database) on monographs. Writes require is_admin().
NIH RePORTER grant/funding records (public data) on monographs. Writes require is_admin().
FDA recall/safety alerts — deliberately public safety information. Writes require is_admin().
Protein Data Bank structure metadata (public data) on monographs. Writes require is_admin().
Computed related-papers listing derived from public literature. Writes require is_admin().

Public share-link feature: rows are addressed by unguessable uuid and are meant to be viewable by anyone holding the link. RLS cannot express 'only if you know the id'; payload contains no account data.
